body.name: \mathfrak D_2^{\mathrm{all,multi}}
body.def: \mathfrak D_2^{\mathrm{all,multi}}=\bigcup_{m=2}^{K-1}\{D(\rho,a,\{b_J\}_{J\in\mathcal J_m}):0<\rho<1,\ a\in\mathcal W,\ b_J\in\operatorname{int}\Sigma_J\text{ for every }J\in\mathcal J_m\}\text{, where batch one uses }\rho a\text{, retains its top }m\text{ empirical arms, and branch }J\text{ uses }(1-\rho)b_J\text{ over its survivors}
body.role: unrestricted-allocation multi-survivor two-batch class for the full residual frontier
